sources.claim: FBI and CISA describe BlackSuit as the evolution of Royal and note numerous coding similarities.
Trend Micro reports high binary similarity between BlackSuit and Royal across Linux and Windows variants.

curator_note: Modeled as derived_from rather than alias_of because official evolution language and reverse-engineering evidence support a successor relationship while Royal and BlackSuit keep distinct timelines.
confidence_reason: The government advisory provides explicit evolution language, and Trend Micro provides independent binary-similarity analysis.
